item.text:
Uses order helpers: totals line items, applies codes, computes an average, and formats a receipt.

Bugs:
- `calcTotal` loops with `i <= items.length`, accessing `items[items.length]` and throwing (`price` of `undefined`). Use `i < items.length`.
- `averageItemPrice` divides an order total by item count, so it returns average line total—not average unit price when `qty > 1`.
- Empty `items` yields `NaN`/division by zero in `averageItemPrice`; decide whether to return `0` or reject it.
